units.source_text: 平时名人把鬓角理得很短，现在却留得很长，梳了个分头，而且把白发染黑，总觉得有点滑稽可笑。

en.t: Usually the Master kept his sideburns trimmed very short, but now he had let them grow long, parted his hair, and even dyed his white hair black, which somehow seemed a little comical.

units.source_text: 但经过理发师剃刀的修剪，褐色的皮肤和高耸的颧骨便裸露出来。

en.t: But after the barber had trimmed him with a razor, his brown skin and high cheekbones were laid bare.
